briefdescription.para: POSIX socket implementation of the SyntropicOS socket port layer.

detaileddescription.para: Provides UDP and TCP socket functions using the standard BSD/POSIX socket API. Works on any platform with POSIX sockets: Linux, macOS, ESP-IDF (lwIP), Zephyr, and any RTOS with a lwIP or POSIX socket shim.
Compile this file into your project alongside your platform's system port (e.g. port_esp32.c for GPIO/timer/UART) to get full networking support.
